answers.core:
The proposal depends on fixing a "bug" in core.


**Addendum:** It should be noted that one can work around [this "bug"](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/6784), e.g. by not invoking any functions defined in the custom `Resource`/`RefCounted` (accessing user-defined variables is fine though). However this is undefined behavior and not guaranteed to be possible indefinitely.
answers.workaround: Yes, but doing so would violate Godot's core principles and could easily lead to memory leaks in large codebases.

title: Give `Resource`s/`RefCounted`s a proper way to react to `NOTIFICATION_PREDELETE`
